plan.english: "Stranger, from which village are you coming?" "I am coming from a far village, and I crossed the great river." "How did you cross the river?" "A shepherd led me, and I followed him." "Stranger, sit down and drink the mead! May the gods protect you."

"Where is the passable path of the mountain?" "It is there, by the river. Do not go in the night. The mountain is great, and wolves live there." "I am not afraid of them, and I carry fire. May the sun lead you."
"Who are you?" "I am a guest. A far road led me." "What are you seeking?" "I seek fire in the night." "Enter, guest, and sit down! It is getting dark. I shall give you mead."
"Brother, where did you go?" "I went to the mountain, and I saw a wolf." "Did you not fear it?" "I feared it, and I ran away." "Come! My mother is seeking you."

"To which field are you driving the herd?" "I am driving it to that field yonder. And you, where are you going?" "I am going to the village, and I seek a friend of mine there." "Your friend has not come. Go by the river, and may the night be good."
"Sister, where is your brother?" "He went to the field." "And what is he doing there?" "He is driving the cattle."
"Give me a pledge and return home!" "I give you a pledge. I shall return, and I shall bring wine." "May Father Sky listen to your word."
"What is your name?" "My name is famous." "Are you a king?" "I am not a king. I am a shepherd, and my name is famous."
"Where shall we cross the river?" "The river is great and swift. Let us sit in the night, and when the dawn comes, we shall cross."
"Wolf, where are you going?" "I am going to the sheep." "Do not go! The shepherd is awake, and I am guarding the sheep."
"Sister, what has happened?" "My brother went to the mountain and did not return." "The gods will protect him, and he will come."
"Have you seen the far mountain?" "I have seen it. A snake lives there." "Lead me there, and I shall give you a reward."
"Where is your horse?" "A beast devoured my horse in the night." "Eat and drink! I shall give you a horse."
"Is the river passable?" "The river is not passable, and the water is swift. Go to the crossing!" "Where is the crossing?" "The crossing is near."

title: The man and the great river

plan.english: The man came to the great river. He saw the water and was afraid, but he crossed the river. The shepherd said: "Where are you going?" He said: "I am going home."
The carpenter and the cook went in the night. The carpenter said: "Cook, I am tired. Let us sit down." The cook said: "The village is not far. Let us go on."
The father went up the mountain. From the mountain he saw the far village, and his heart was glad. He said: "Father Sky, you are leading me, and I shall return home."
The shepherd, driving the herd, looked at a wolf on the mountain. He said: "Dog, guard the cattle!" The dog ran, and the wolf fled.
The king drove a chariot to the mountain. His son followed him. The king said: "The road is far and good." And he said: "Father, I am not afraid."
The mistress was seeking her own sheep. She came to a man and said: "Did you see my sheep?" He said: "I saw it yesterday." Then she went to the mountain, and her own heart trembled.
Three men sat on the mountain. Night came, and the fire burned. He said: "Who is awake?" Another man said: "I am awake. I guard the fire."
The man led the swift horses to the river. He was not afraid of the water. He said: "Swift horses, carry me!" The horses crossed the river, and he followed them.
When the dawn became bright, the two men stood up and went away. The other said: "Bright Dawn, lead us!" The sun grew bright.

title: The guest at the door of the house

plan.english: The guest came to the door and said: "May I sit down by your fire?" The mistress said: "The guest is dear to the gods." And she gave him mead.
In the night the man went astray. He saw a fire on the mountain and went to it. The shepherd said: "You went astray, but the path is near. Follow me!"
"What did you see?" "I saw a great snake." "Where was the snake lying?" "It was lying by the river." "Did you flee?" "I fled."
In three nights the man went away, and in the fourth night he arrived again. The mistress stood at the door and said: "You have come!"
The son came home unharmed. His mother saw him at the door and said: "You have come! The gods protected you." He said: "Mother, I saw the river and the mountain."
In many years the man arrived at his own door. No one recognised him, but the dog recognised him, and ran to him. He said: "Dog, you know me!"
At evening the husband came home. The wife stood at the door and said: "You have come! Eat and drink, and tell what you saw."

title: The sister runs to her brother

plan.english: The sister saw her own brother, and her heart was glad. She ran to him and said: "Brother, you are alive!"
At evening the father drove the herd home. The wife said: "Are the sheep alive?" He said: "They are alive. A wolf came, but the dog scared it away."
The king returned home. The men said: "King, your fame is great! May your fame be imperishable."
The brother returned from the mountain. He said: "Sister, I bring you wool and wine." She said: "You are dear to me."
"Man, who are you?" "Mother, I am your son." "My son went to the mountain and did not return." "I have returned, mother." "I know your word!"
After a year the sister returned home. Someone said: "Sister, you have grown! Your name is famous."
"How did you come?" "The gods protected me, and the dog led me. I fled from the beast and returned home unharmed."
At evening the mother stood at the door and looked at the road. She saw someone on the road, and her heart knew him. She ran and said: "Son!"
"The son has come! Let us eat and drink. Bring the mead, mistress!" And the father gave him wine.
At dawn he went along the river and looked at the smoke of the village. He said: "Smoke!" And his own heart was glad.
